title: Restore the public storage witness on standalone installations
goal: Vision: V-6. Retain native Git storage audits and directed-deletion witness behavior in a clean core installation, keeping the authorized workflow provider authoritative when installed.

reuse.searched: Reused the original Apache-2.0 guard and tests at 43664bd065, the wire Report, and git_governor::workflow_call_or. xtask storage/tap commands reexport this same public guard. The paired provider remains authoritative. Fund the native witness by generating public tool attributes and catalog entries from existing registry rows, retaining both historical wire catalogs and the daemon's public dispatch contract.
